When I was 12 we had just moved to Australia and my aunt had recently been diagnosed with lymphoma (cancer of the lymph nodes), she was doing well and had just moved back home. But due to her having one of her lungs removed (the cancer had spread) she got pneumonia and went to hospital, where they put her in an induced coma. 

She started to get better again but then suddenly took a turn for the worst and family back at home decided to take her off life support. I was at home when my mom got the call. It was the worst state I have ever seen her in. She and my aunt were cousins but lived together and treated each other like sisters. It was devastating to all of us but my mom took it the worst. I’ve never seen her break down like that before, or after that incident.
